text: 3 PREFACE At the dawn of the 19th century when nationalism was introduced to the Balkans and as new states began to form out of the ashes of the Ottoman Empire, dialectal languages were viewed as simplistic, backwards, limited and, to some degree, expressionless.
text_raw:
3
PREFACE
At the dawn of the 19th century when nationalism was introduced to the
Balkans and as new states began to form out of the ashes of the Ottoman
Empire, dialectal languages were viewed as simplistic, backwards, limited
and, to some degree, expressionless.

text: They were deemed vulgar and were scoffed at.
text_raw:
They were deemed vulgar and were
scoffed at.

text: Modern and literary languages were created to replace them and students were discouraged from speaking them because they were presented as the languages of uneducated peasants.
text_raw:
Modern and literary languages were created to replace them and
students were discouraged from speaking them because they were
presented as the languages of uneducated peasants.

text: Generations later, as the newly created societies began to culturally mature and search for their roots, attitudes towards dialectal languages began to change.
text_raw:
Generations later, as the newly created societies began to culturally
mature and search for their roots, attitudes towards dialectal languages
began to change.

text: Dialects began to be seen no longer as vulgar and limited but rather as the mothers of modern languages and the sources of modern cultures.
text_raw:
Dialects began to be seen no longer as vulgar and limited
but rather as the mothers of modern languages and the sources of modern
cultures.

text: Dialectal languages, at least in the Balkans, are the most natural and longest lasting cultural elements that not only defined the uniqueness of certain societies but also, in a positive way, highlight the diversities within them.
text_raw:
Dialectal languages, at least in the Balkans, are the most natural and
longest lasting cultural elements that not only defined the uniqueness of
certain societies but also, in a positive way, highlight the diversities within
them.

text: The Balkans has always been a multicultural, multiethnic region with various ethnicities living together.
text_raw:
The Balkans has always been a multicultural, multiethnic region
with various ethnicities living together.

text: Languages have been the predominant factors of cultural divide in a positive way.
text_raw:
Languages have been the
predominant factors of cultural divide in a positive way.

text: And within each culture, at least with the Macedonians, a number of micro-cultures existed predominantly defined by unique characteristics such as dress, colour, pattern, song, dance and obviously dialectal language.

text: Before the introduction of nationalism these cultural elements were seen as positive characteristics that uniquely identified each micro-culture in those societies.

text: By 1969 its population had dropped to less than a dozen people.

text: Oshchima was hard hit and nearly destroyed by the Greek Civil War and most of its residents fled for Canada, Australia, the USA and the Republic of Macedonia.

text: 5 Introduction The dialectal Macedonian language presented here is a naturally evolving oral language that has been in use uncodified for many centuries.
text_raw:
5
Introduction
The dialectal Macedonian language presented here is a naturally
evolving oral language that has been in use uncodified for many centuries.

text: I have made every effort to present it in its exact form as it was spoken by generations before me and without grammatical adjustments or corrections.
text_raw:
I have made every effort to present it in its exact form as it was spoken by
generations before me and without grammatical adjustments or
corrections.

text: Like most natural languages, it follows logical patterns but not without some exceptions.
text_raw:
Like most natural languages, it follows logical patterns but not
without some exceptions.

text: My intent here was to document words and phrases as I remember them spoken and to not necessarily explain them grammatically.
text_raw:
